verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail has a public pricing page that presents plans with mail scanning, forwarding and unlimited cloud storage (docs-28, docs-34). The check-deposit page says deposits are pay-per-deposit with no setup or monthly fees (docs-3, docs-4). However, no actual dollar amounts, scan allowances or per-item fees appear anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: actual monthly plan prices, per-plan scan allowances, per-item fees for extra scans and forwarding, a stated check deposit fee amount, and independent confirmation that the pricing is complete with no hidden fees.
